component.name: Phosrack
component.summary: A compact modular music rack for Spotify
Un rack musical compacto y modular para Spotify
Un rack musical compact et modulaire pour Spotify

description.p: Phosrack is a desktop music rack inspired by classic modular media players. Its compact interface offers Spotify playback, search, queue and library views with original audio-reactive phosphor visuals.

Configure your own Spotify developer Client ID and authorize your Premium account in the browser. Integrated playback uses the official Web Playback SDK inside Qt WebEngine and requires a compatible existing Widevine module, which is not bundled. An external Spotify player mode is also available. Spotify's application-access restrictions still apply.

The local tools provide a ten-band equalizer and five visual effects, including a phosphor grid and a display of predominant notes and probable chords. Fullscreen can show the current and next Spotify tracks.
Add an 8 by 6 phosphor grid, a notes and chords visualizer, and four equalizer presets.
Use the equalizer and reactive visuals alongside Spotify. Fullscreen keeps the header visible and shows the next track only when one is queued.
Restore saved Spotify sessions on startup and show a clear sign-in prompt when browser authorization is needed.
Reduce background requests, preserve Spotify cooldowns across restarts and show a live wait time.
Complete browser authorization with a localized, accessible Phosrack confirmation page.
Keep Spotify playback separate from non-Spotify local audio analysis and equalization, with a clear initial privacy and terms notice.
Play Spotify inside Phosrack with Qt WebEngine and the official Web Playback SDK, or choose an external player in Settings.
Set up your own Client ID, detect or choose an existing Widevine module, and reconnect older sessions for the new playback permissions. No shared Spotify Client ID or Widevine module is bundled.
The compact rack keeps its phosphor styling and dedicated fullscreen visualizer, with a simpler title strip.
